scope: Read-only review of locked package and task validation for normal trials and recovery.
acceptance: Verify both paths hold the same lock through validation and state changes, reject stale packages and release on refusal. Use synthetic fixtures only.

result.verdict: Pass for lock ownership and stale-package refusal.
result.evidence: Both Windows fixture suites passed. A competing open failed during task validation. A stale package released the lock on refusal. Both normal and recovery paths held the same lock through their state changes.
result.limitations: The reviewer used synthetic fixtures. No hosted reader credential, installed private baseline or live interruption was exercised.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the reviewed source and Windows fixtures.
acknowledgment.next: Qualify the protected private trial with a disposable repository, an independently checked ref and an issuer-scoped reader.

scope: Recheck protected process startup, scope preflight, durable recovery record and stale-state refusal in the credentialed baseline trial.
acceptance: Verify the fixes with isolated fixtures and report the remaining hosted and operator checks. No real credentials or installation.

result.verdict: Preflight and interruption fixes passed, with a remaining package-validation race.
result.evidence: Fourteen focused tests passed. The fixture verified the clean child, declined v5, restored before and after activation, and preserved unrelated credentials. The reviewer found the installed digest and task checks preceded lock acquisition.
result.limitations: The environment fixture used synthetic validators. The reviewer separately exercised the real validator; an additional local harness was blocked by execution review.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. Moved the installed package and task identity checks under the common install lock.
acknowledgment.next: Verify lock lifetime and stale package refusal on the final revision.

scope: Repeat the credential prompt mismatch and interrupted private trial scenarios using only operator documentation.
acceptance: Identify safe cancellation, issuer revocation, the recovery selector, and the exit condition for retry. No live actions.

result.verdict: Pass for prompt mismatch and interrupted-trial tabletop.
result.evidence: The operator selected cancellation before secret entry, issuer revocation before recovery, the recorded trial ID and installed digest, and held retry on foreign state.
result.limitations: No real prompt, token, issuer change or live recovery was exercised.

acknowledgment.next: Exercise the normal private baseline check only after provisioning a repository-scoped reader.

scope: Trace v5 and v6 grant admission, subscription and the interactive private setup trial using synthetic data only.
acceptance: Check operator-supplied secrets, exact destination, package and cleanup, recipient disclosure, and limits before hosted use.

result.verdict: Hold real credential entry pending isolated preflight and interruption recovery.
result.evidence: The reviewer traced v6 admission and authenticated activation, observed process environment inheritance with a harmless canary, and identified the missing ownership record and older-package preflight gap.
result.limitations: No elevated or hosted trial. Matching a revision alone cannot prove issuer permissions or that anonymous access is denied.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. Use the existing isolated verifier, check v6 admission before prompting, and record exact intended changes before the first credential write.
acknowledgment.next: Recheck isolated startup and guarded recovery at the fixed revision.

scope: Use the public setup guide to plan the private baseline check in an isolated operator scenario. No secret, account, network or elevated task.
acceptance: Identify prerequisites, where to enter the password, proof of read-only scope versus proof of reading, and recovery if the prompt names a different repository.

result.verdict: Pass for tabletop preparation and cancellation on a target mismatch.
result.evidence: The operator identified issuer permissions, the canonical URL and ref, the masked desktop prompt, and the independently expected revision.
result.limitations: Cancellation on mismatch was implicit. No participant entered a credential or ran the installed trial.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. The revision makes cancellation explicit and includes a recovery command.
acknowledgment.next: Repeat the affected scenarios under the revised guide.

scope: Inspect the final directory census and repeat the interrupted operator scenario using the revised guide and an isolated fixture.
acceptance: Verify that unexpected files preserve the trial record and block retry. Check the ordinary and interrupted cleanup paths and report untested cases.

result.verdict: Pass for the final inventory check and recovery guidance.
result.evidence: The operator repeated the interrupted scenario. The reviewer ran the committed cleanup conditional in two disposable Windows directories. Unknown content and the trial record survived byte-for-byte, while a clean trial was removed.
result.limitations: No live crash, concurrent writer, protected ACL, scheduled task or installed recovery was exercised in this fixture.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the documented manual recovery and filesystem checks.
acknowledgment.next: Confirm normal cleanup separately after each installed trial.

scope: Read-only recheck of digest and inventory limits, exact ciphertext validation, reports-only isolation and manual trial recovery.
acceptance: Verify dispositions against reviewed bytes and report residual gaps. Only synthetic checks are permitted.

result.verdict: Pass for source-level storage and proceeding to installed synthetic trials.
result.evidence: Six Windows tests passed. The reviewer confirmed the inventory stopped at entry 33, the receipt read was capped at 64 bytes, unseal rechecked the ciphertext digest and reports-only startup skipped production credential inventory.
result.limitations: An abrupt stop before the recovery record is created or after its removal can leave a partial directory for manual inspection. No installed or hosted trial was run by the reviewer.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. No public credentialed grants are enabled. The final cleanup refinement has its own review.
acknowledgment.next: Install the reviewed module and verifier packages, then compare synthetic challenge receipts with independent expected values.

scope: Walk the interrupted trial recovery from the public guide using simulated status only. No production changes, elevation or worker source.
acceptance: Describe the evidence needed before removal, how to distinguish the two credential directories and when to preserve an unexpected artifact.

result.verdict: Hold retry in the simulated interrupted trial.
result.evidence: The operator identified the lock, installed digest, scoped task and trial evidence, distinguished the production directory, and retained the unexpected entry.
result.limitations: Document walkthrough only. The guide left retention of the valid record alongside the unexpected entry implicit.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. The guide now explicitly retains the record, and cleanup checks for unknown entries before removing it.
acknowledgment.next: Repeat the affected recovery scenario and review the final cleanup change.

scope: Read-only review of Windows ciphertext inventory, bounded opening, decryption, offline trial and restoration. Use synthetic data only.
acceptance: Identify authority, disclosure and recovery gaps. Check that the trial cannot operate on production records and report limits separately from the installed trial.

result.verdict: Hold closure for bounded receipt and inventory reads, exact ciphertext checking on decrypt, and incomplete cleanup.
result.evidence: Six focused Windows checks passed. The reviewer traced the protected directory, synthetic binding and disabled public grants. Reports-only startup could still enumerate production metadata.
result.limitations: No installed trial, hosted endpoint, real credential or interrupted-machine recovery.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted all findings. Restricted reads, skipped production Git inventory in reports-only mode, and documented manual recovery with a protected task record.
acknowledgment.next: Independently recheck the fixes and preserve the distinction between a simulated recovery and an interrupted installed trial.

scope: Stage the package chain using a synthetic base, the public operator guide and normal package CLI. No live installer, elevation or network.
acceptance: Verify the final package, identify the correct digest for the protected trial, exercise recovery from a mistaken base digest and record friction.

result.verdict: Pass for synthetic package staging and recovery.
result.evidence: The operator recovered from a mismatched second base digest using only public guidance. The real CLI verified the final package and the operator identified its digest for the installed trial.
result.limitations: The operator did not install packages, run the protected trial or represent a human participant.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the two-stage operator workflow. The guide identifies which receipt belongs to the second stage.
acknowledgment.next: Qualify the installed protected trial separately.

scope: Review the branch sampler, its trusted reader contract and the synthetic authorization checks. Use isolated fixtures only.
acceptance: Trace exact resource and authority checks to the record open, decryption and process launch. Check errors and credential exposure, the installed default and the distinction between source and live evidence.

result.verdict: Pass for a sampler with a trusted conforming reader.
result.evidence: Fifteen focused tests passed. Five independent recording probes counted reads, decryptions and launches at distinct revocation points. Six offline Git configuration lookups confirmed descendant header matching and sibling exclusion.
result.limitations: The installed policy accepts anonymous reads only. The future adapter must bound the open, close synchronously, validate file access and decrypt only its supplied bytes. Authenticated HTTP, installed cross-account retrieval and erasure of child environment copies were unproved.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the guarded sampler. The separate Windows reader and a live authenticated transport remain open.
acknowledgment.next: Qualify bounded ciphertext reads and resource-bound decryption with synthetic data before connecting an installed credential record.

scope: Read-only review of the branch package refresh, updater and tests.
acceptance: Check the allowed delta, base validation, restart and rollback. Return findings, evidence and limits.

result.evidence: Two focused Windows tests passed. The reviewer traced the complete base and output checks, three permitted modules, protected directory swap, startup check and rollback.
result.limitations: Recovery fixtures exercise the shared swap routine through the schedule update. Abrupt interruption during an individual staging copy and installed operation were untested.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the package and updater change. A partial staging file can require operator inspection before a retry.
acknowledgment.next: Check installed package membership, reports-only startup and observation on each desktop.

scope: Exercise staging with public operator documentation and an isolated synthetic package. No elevation, network, implementation access or installation.
acceptance: Discover staging, recover from an incorrect digest, verify the resulting package and identify the read-only installation check. Record friction and limits.

result.verdict: Pass for the constrained staging and recovery walkthrough.
result.evidence: Using the operator guide and public CLI, the agent chose the refresh command, observed refusal of an incorrect digest and no output directory, recovered with the journal digest and independently verified the new digest. It identified the read-only Plan command.
result.limitations: The CLI verification error alone did not identify the wrong digest. The guide supplied recovery. The operator used a synthetic package and did not run the installed Plan or represent a human participant.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted. Keep a common verification error for a mismatched digest or damaged package. The guide gives the safe recovery for either case.
acknowledgment.next: Exercise Plan and Apply with the installed packages and check the journal and heartbeat independently.

scope: Read-only review of the grant recheck and regression at the pinned candidate. Check the normal broker path, live authority, cancellation, test validity and the limits of the source-only conclusion.
acceptance: Report approval or blockers and the evidence and limits for source integration. Use only synthetic tests.

result.verdict: Pass for source integration of the anonymous prelaunch authorization fix.
result.evidence: The reviewer traced the broker policy read, subscription state, pin checks and process spawn. In an independent synthetic probe, a permitted grant launched once. Withdrawal, policy read error, an asynchronous authorization result and cancellation at the final pin launched zero times. An omitted check opened no pins.
result.limitations: No live provider, installed broker, network or private credential was used. The policy read and OS process creation are separate operations. The fix closes the asynchronous pin-verification window.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for the reviewed code. The public CLI and MCP interactions are unchanged. The coordinator also exercised the subscription and poll path with the recording adapter.
acknowledgment.next: Verify the updated installed package before enabling that path. Design and qualify the distinct credential-read authorization before provisioning a real credential.

scope: Read-only source and test review of remote receive, send, proof, and watcher grant and credential boundaries.
acceptance: Return prioritized findings, source evidence, a scoped verdict and unverified areas.

result.verdict: Hold the first private credential. A/B and watcher closure remain open.
result.evidence: Static inspection of the restricted Codex route, proof and recovery tests, watcher authorization, and the installed trial journal. Findings are listed under Independent implementation review in the rollout journal.
result.limitations: No fresh test runs, provider sessions, network calls, credentials or installed machine inspection by the reviewer.

acknowledgment.disposition: Review received directly from the independent subagent. Preserve the documented live qualifications within their original scope. Track all six findings as open.
acknowledgment.next: Exercise grant removal during pin verification and enforce a fresh grant check before credential access and Git launch. Return the fix to independent review.

scope: Read-only review of the committed protocol, register, validator, tests and CI wiring.
acceptance: Check the draft findings against the committed changes and identify residual enforcement and visible-window qualification limits.

result.evidence: The independent reviewer extracted the committed files and ran both workflow commands. The regression test passed and the committed register validated. The journal covers all workers and requires a coordinator acknowledgment.
result.limitations: A snapshot cannot prove dispatch order, identity, independence, evidence quality or blocker resolution. The reviewer did not test hosted CI, branch settings or visible desktop launches.

acknowledgment.disposition: Accepted for structural checks. The protocol is a project instruction. GitHub main had no required checks or branch rules at review time, and desktop qualification remains open.
acknowledgment.next: For the first separate visible worker on each desktop, verify the interactive window, assignment receipt, durable result and return to the original coordinator before recording that route as qualified.
